name: FIR-Bench-Research-Reports-FinQA
description: A benchmark built from financial research reports that measures models' ability to answer finance-focused questions requiring numerical reasoning, information extraction, and understanding of corporate disclosures. Tasks typically involve reading dense financial text and producing precise, often numeric, answers grounded in the source report.
reputation: Niche dataset with limited but growing use among finance-focused NLP researchers and teams working on numerical QA.
